The PKGBUILD downloads AppImages from Tencent's official domain (dldir1v6.qq.com) with SHA256 checksums, uses standard eval for architecture-dependent variable indirection (not code execution), and performs expected AppImage extraction. All three reports resulted in 'inconclusive' due to tool failures (HTTP 400 errors, empty LLM responses, parsing failures), not conflicting security assessments. Report 3's unparsed 'unsafe' flag on the update script appears to be a false positive from a content safety filter rather than a genuine security finding.

learnings: API reliability issues (HTTP 400, empty responses) are causing coverage gaps that force inconclusive verdicts even when available evidence is sufficient
